freshly_checked_applications.theorem: Lemma 3.2; Proposition 3.3; Remark 3.5; Proposition 3.7, first alternative (condition F)
freshly_checked_applications.statement_used: Continuous full residual determinant functor is represented by a profinite local W(k)-algebra; condition F makes it Noetherian with finite power-series presentation.
hypotheses_checked: Actual groups are profinite and k is finite of characteristic ell.
Global residual representation is the original diagonal sum of pulled-back characters; local applications have degree one.
Global condition F follows from actual finite topological generation and open-subgroup Schreier; local condition F is exactly T.phiV for every open subgroup.
Every IsCO target is a profinite local ring with finite Artin quotients; continuity agrees with original IsCont.
Original O is treated by explicit W(k)-to-O and completed relative power-series quotient in PRG4/PRG6; flatness is not presumed.
No ell>n, absolute irreducibility, trace-only determinant or n! invertibility premise is used; rank zero handled independently.

freshly_checked_applications.statement_used: A power-series ring in finitely many variables over a Noetherian ring is Noetherian.
hypotheses_checked: Every base ring is IsCO and hence Noetherian, or the given coefficient DVR.
All variable index sets Unit, Fin D, Fin q times Fin n and finite presentation variables are finite.

freshly_checked_applications.statement_used: Completion is exact on finite modules and equals tensor with the completed base.
hypotheses_checked: Base rings are Noetherian; the ideal used is their maximal ideal.
Modules are finite modules, ideals or quotients of finite modules; submodules are finite by Noetherianity.
The bases are complete, so finite modules and their quotients are complete; Krull intersection supplies separation.

freshly_checked_applications.precise_import: Finite-variable formal power-series rings, finite algebras and localizations of Noetherian rings are Noetherian; submodules of finite modules are finite.
hypotheses_checked: R and L0 are Noetherian by S5; O is a DVR; all variable sets are finite.
The faithful action algebras are submodules of explicit finite free endomorphism modules.

freshly_checked_applications.theorem: Theorem 2.22(ii), pp. 34-35 in the cited version
freshly_checked_applications.statement_used: A Cayley-Hamilton determinant over a henselian local base with split multiplicity-free residual law gives a generalized matrix algebra with the determinant trace; in rank-one residual blocks its diagonal corners are the base ring.
hypotheses_checked: C is the actual IsCO complete Noetherian local quotient; henselianity is established by the coprime-factor lifting argument.
E is the ordinary full Cayley-Hamilton quotient C[H]/CH(D); PQL7 proves CH(D) lies in the full determinant kernel.
The residual characters are the actual distinct pulled-back characters, hence split multiplicity free with every block of rank one.
Degree is positive, in particular n=4, and ell=3 is allowed.
The theorem's multiplicity-free alternative is used with no finite generation of E, absolute irreducibility, ell>n or n! inversion.

freshly_checked_applications.statement_used: Faithfully flat maps are surjective on spectra; a flat local map is faithfully flat; flat maps satisfy going down.
hypotheses_checked: PRG18 proves the exact Spo is finite free of positive rank over the original B.
B to Spo is consequently flat and faithful, so a prime exists above the exact original kernel p.
The localized B_p to Spo_P is flat and local; going down lifts both endpoint primes below the single selected P.
All contractions are equalities; no primes over unrelated splitting factors are used.

note: Exact hypotheses are checked in each certificate. These applications do not produce original arithmetic TWAut/Hida or actual common geometry.
